entities.summary: Hon. Auberon Edward William Molyneux Herbert was an English writer, theorist, philosopher, and 19th century individualist. He was a son of the 3rd Earl of Carnarvon. He was a Liberal Member of Parliament for the two-member constituency of Nottingham from 1870 to 1874.
